# Old Year Book Tables of East Asia

> Statistical tables, directories (Who's Who, firms) and chronologies transcribed from English- and Japanese-language
> yearbooks and handbooks on Japan, China, Korea, Taiwan and Manchuria, 1905–1950. Every figure was transcribed from
> page images by a vision model (Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 or Haiku 5.5, named on each book's page) and must be
> checked against the original scan, which each table and entry links to.

Please do not crawl `pagefind/` or `pagefind-titles/`: they are the search index behind `search.html`, about 188,000
small binary files with nothing that is not on the book pages. To read or analyse the collection, download it in one
go from GitHub instead of fetching pages or index files one by one.

## Bulk data

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/kmlawson/playground-stat-tables): the whole site and its data
- [ZIP of the repository](https://github.com/kmlawson/playground-stat-tables/archive/refs/heads/main.zip): one download
- [data/](https://github.com/kmlawson/playground-stat-tables/tree/main/data): one JSON file per book (`<slug>.json`:
  tables with title, chapter, printed pages, columns, rows, printed footnotes, transcriber's notes and scan links;
  `<slug>-directory.json` and `<slug>-chronology.json` where the book has them)
- [downloads/](https://github.com/kmlawson/playground-stat-tables/tree/main/downloads): per book, an Excel workbook
  of the tables and Markdown files of the directories and chronologies

## Pages

- [All books](index.html): one card per book, grouped by region
- `book/<slug>/`: a book's tables; `book/<slug>/directory.html` and `chronology.html` where it has them
- [Full Search](search.html): searches every book (needs the pagefind index on the server)

## Notes on the data

- `"[?]"` in a cell means the figure could not be read in the scan; `""` means the cell is blank in the original.
- Printed totals were checked; where they do not add up, the transcriber's notes say so. Misprints are kept as printed.
